title: The Couple Next Door
author: Shari Lapena
summary: A couple goes to a dinner party next door and leaves their baby asleep at home with a monitor. When they come back, she is gone, and the police suspect the parents.
readIf: you want a fast thriller that keeps shifting your suspicions and ends on a sting.
skipIf: you find stories involving a missing baby too upsetting, since it is the whole premise.

pairings.reason: Another quick, domestic thriller where a perfect-looking couple is hiding something.
A richer and wittier look at secrets behind respectable neighbourhood doors.
The more ambitious and cynical model for domestic thrillers about what couples hide.
